# fetchr

> An open-source HTTP client with browser TLS fingerprinting (JA3/JA4, HTTP/2, QUIC) — available as a CLI, an MCP server that gives Claude Desktop & Claude Code real HTTP access, and an importable Go package. Requests look like Chrome or Firefox, so they pass anti-bot/TLS-fingerprint detection that blocks standard HTTP clients and curl.

fetchr is open source (thesatellite-ai/fetchr), licensed Apache-2.0.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/fetchr/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, CLI + MCP usage
- [USAGE](https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/fetchr/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md): full command/flag/tool reference + fingerprinting guide
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/fetchr/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): development setup + architecture
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/fetchr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history

## Install
- AI skill: `npx skills add thesatellite-ai/fetchr`
- Script (macOS/Linux): `curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thesatellite-ai/fetchr/main/install.sh | sh`
- Go: `go install github.com/thesatellite-ai/fetchr/cmd/fetchr@latest`
- Releases: https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/fetchr/releases
